fichas.title: Intersections
fichas.summary: Intersections are classified as grade-separated, where roads cross at different levels and connect by ramps or slip roads, or at-grade, including T-junctions and crossroads. Illustrated treatments include turn-widened approaches, grade-separated junctions, carriageway narrowing, roundabouts, and staggered crossings. Roundabouts can reduce serious accidents, noise, and speed, and may remove the need for traffic-light control. Staggered crossings are suitable for slower traffic in residential areas. Building restrictions apply alongside federal main roads.
uses: Connect roads at the same or different levels
Provide crossings suitable for slower residential traffic
